_about: Licence policy for every third-party component this product ships. Read by scripts/licence_inventory.py, generate_third_party_notices.py and check_licences.py. A change here is a licensing decision: say why in the entry (docs/soc2/policies/vendor-and-subprocessor-management-policy.md, Licence compliance).

library_copyleft_reasons.python:svglib: Used unmodified as a Python library and replaceable by the operator (pip); it converts SVG for report output only.
library_copyleft_reasons.python:psycopg2-binary: Used unmodified as the PostgreSQL driver and replaceable by the operator (pip); the licence carries a linking exception for OpenSSL.

python:cssselect2.evidence: Packaged LICENSE file is the BSD 3-Clause text; the metadata names no clause count.

python:jinja2.evidence: Packaged LICENSE.txt is the BSD 3-Clause text (Pallets); the metadata gives only the BSD classifier.

python:passlib.evidence: Packaged LICENSE states the BSD licence with a no-endorsement clause (three clauses); the metadata says only BSD.

python:psycopg2-binary.evidence: Packaged LICENSE: LGPL version 3 or later with a special exception for linking with OpenSSL.

python:pyperclip.evidence: Packaged LICENSE.txt is the BSD 3-Clause text; the metadata names no licence.

python:python-dateutil.evidence: Packaged LICENSE: Apache 2.0 for newer contributions, BSD 3-Clause for earlier ones; the metadata says only Dual License.

python:qrcode.evidence: Packaged LICENSE is the BSD 3-Clause text; the metadata says only BSD.

python:reportlab.evidence: Packaged LICENSE is the BSD 3-Clause text (ReportLab Inc.); the metadata is a free-text sentence.

python:resvg-py.evidence: Packaged LICENSE is the MIT text (baseplate-admin); the metadata declares no licence.

python:sniffio.evidence: Packaged LICENSE offers either LICENSE.MIT or LICENSE.APACHE2.

python:tinycss2.evidence: Packaged LICENSE is the BSD 3-Clause text; the metadata gives only the BSD classifier.

python:webencodings.evidence: Packaged LICENSE is the BSD 3-Clause text; the metadata gives only the BSD classifier.

npm:khroma.evidence: Installed licence file is the MIT text; package.json declares no licence.

npm:require-like.evidence: Installed License file is the MIT permission notice; package.json declares no licence.

python:3.15-slim.note: Debian slim; each package's licence is in /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright inside the image.

python:3.12-slim.note: Debian slim; each package's licence is in /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright inside the image.

node:26-alpine.note: Builds the front end and the documentation site; nothing from this stage is in a published image except the compiled output.

nginx:1.31-alpine.note: Alpine; each package's licence is in /usr/share/licenses inside the image.

nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.30-alpine.note: Alpine; each package's licence is in /usr/share/licenses inside the image.

system_components.name: Ghostscript
system_components.role: Converts uploaded EPS logos to SVG.
system_components.reason: Runs as a separate process inside the converter container (subprocess call); never linked into or imported by this product's code, and not modified. The Debian package source is the source offer.

system_components.name: poppler-utils
system_components.role: Converts uploaded PDF logos to SVG.
system_components.reason: Runs as a separate process inside the converter container (subprocess call); never linked into or imported by this product's code, and not modified. The Debian package source is the source offer.

system_components.name: URW++ base 35 fonts
system_components.role: Stand-in PostScript fonts (Helvetica, Times) for EPS files that do not embed them.
system_components.reason: Data files read by Ghostscript in the converter container; the font exception keeps documents that embed them out of the licence's scope (Debian copyright file: AGPL-3 with Font exception).

system_components.name: zlib
system_components.role: Compression library, named so the patched Debian release replaces the base image's copy.

system_components.name: PostgreSQL client libraries
system_components.role: Client library for the database driver build, and pg_dump for the backup image.
system_components.reason: Permissive (PostgreSQL licence); the Debian copyright file also lists BSD-3-Clause parts.

system_components.name: GCC
system_components.role: Compiler present in the image from the dependency build.
system_components.reason: A build tool; nothing it produced is a derivative of GCC (the runtime library exception), and the application does not link or call it. Debian package source is the source offer.

system_components.name: restic
system_components.role: Encrypted backup repository tool run by the backup image.

system_components.name: OpenSSH client
system_components.licence: BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND ISC AND MIT
system_components.reason: Permissive (BSD-style); the Debian copyright file lists the component licences.

system_components.name: GnuPG
system_components.role: Verifies the PostgreSQL repository key while the backup image is built.
system_components.reason: Removed again in the same layer, so it is not in the published image.

system_components.name: nginx
system_components.role: Web server for the front end and the documentation site.
system_components.reason: Permissive; comes with the base image (the documentation image also upgrades the package itself so a security release is taken).

fonts.name: Liberation Sans, Serif and Mono
fonts.note: Liberation 2 (Red Hat; digitised data copyright Google), used as the default report fonts.

fonts.name: DejaVu Sans
fonts.where: backend: diagrams and mathematics in reports
fonts.note: Bitstream Vera licence; DejaVu's own changes are in the public domain.

fonts.name: KaTeX fonts
fonts.note: Computer Modern and AMS derived fonts; KaTeX's font sources carry the SIL Open Font License 1.1 notice.

notes: Grafana, Loki, Tempo and Alloy (AGPL-3.0) and cAdvisor and Prometheus (Apache-2.0) are optional observability services that Compose pulls from their publishers; this repository neither builds nor redistributes them.
The development profiling image adds memray (Apache-2.0) and py-spy (MIT); it is built only by developers and never published.
The Playwright test project and the performance tooling are not part of any image and are outside the inventory.
